children: Google (GOOG) traffic showed little sign of disruption from rising AI chatbot use in August, with global daily visits increasing 3% from a year earlier to 2.8 billion, Bank of America said, citing Similarweb data.

The figures highlight a widening gap between Google and newer AI services. ChatGPT recorded 181 million daily web visits, down 5% year over year, while Google's Gemini jumped 261%. Anthropic's Claude climbed 533%, and Meta Platforms (META) saw traffic rise 175%.
Mobile activity told a similar story, though Google remained far ahead. Its daily active users reached 2.3 billion, up 12% year over year, compared with 469 million for ChatGPT, which grew 37%.
Gemini's mobile audience surged 284% to 126 million, while Claude increased 1,017% to 19 million. Meta AI also posted 583% growth to 5 million users.

Bank of America said the data points to expanding AI adoption without a broad decline in Google search usage. The firm expects investor attention to shift toward how quickly ChatGPT's advertising business develops.

title: Bank of America Has a Stark Message for Google Stock as AI Rivals Surge
